doc.ownership: Every emitted Flycast config line, native action name, and SDL scancode lives in this declaration. The emitter only validates the rows against emulator.json, steam_input.json, and steamdeck.skm before rendering them.
doc.gameplay: The generated keyboard mapping is action-only. Flycast's upstream SDL GameController mapping remains responsible for Dreamcast gameplay, analog triggers, Start, D-pad, and rumble.
doc.hotkeys: Flycast version-4 combo rows use simultaneous SDL scancodes (sequential=0): Left Ctrl is 224; A/S/J/K/X are 4/22/13/14/27. They invoke Flycast's native load/save/slot/screenshot actions (core/input/mapping.cpp:50-72). Its own menu (btn_menu) and exit (btn_escape) are not bound: ui.menu and app.quit are Semu's, or Ctrl+M would open Flycast's settings over Semu's menu.
doc.state: No external save path is configured. Flycast therefore stores per-game VMUs and save states in the isolated XDG_DATA_HOME/flycast tree declared by emulator.json.
doc.disc_picker: emu.cfg [config] BoxartDisplayMode = no and FetchBoxart = no: in box-art mode the Insert Disk picker shows every disc of a game as the same cover and title, so the discs of a playlist could not be told apart. List mode shows the (Disc N).chd file names, and nothing is fetched from TheGamesDB.
doc.save_states: Flycast cycles ten slots and wraps (cycleSaveStateSlot, core/ui/gui.cpp:518-522), shows slot + 1 (gui.cpp:1620-1624) and saves the choice to emu.cfg [Dreamcast] SavestateSlot; Semu pins it to 0 each launch, where its own counter starts.

native_shortcuts.why: GamepadDevice::find_mapping uses mappings/SDL_Keyboard.cfg whenever it exists; KeyboardInputMapping's defaults (bare X, C, S, D as Dreamcast buttons, Tab for the menu, Space for fast forward) apply only without the file. Semu writes the whole file with empty [digital] and [analog] sections, so a chord like Ctrl+S presses no Dreamcast button. A per-game SDL_Keyboard_<id>.cfg the owner makes would still win.
